dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: Preparation comes first. Only after can we face the Wild Hunt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you readied so far?

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: Well, let me see... I have a special scent to lure the Mandragoras, Wolfhook for guiding Slothsheep...

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: Oh dear, looks like I nearly forgot to bring along that Spirebloom specimen I spent so long preparing. Thank you for reminding me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it then...

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: Hmm... I keep feeling like I've forgotten something. But what could it be...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Um... Why exactly would you need these to deal with the Wild Hunt?

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: Ha! These are my special tricks of the trade. You can't just confront the Wild Hunt head-on and expect to win.

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: If you've ever taken a close look at our local flora and fauna, you'd have noticed that, thanks to the effects of kuuvahki, they've all adapted to resist Abyssal corruption in their own ways.

dialogues.speaker: Valdis
dialogues.text: We can set up traps around the camp using that knowledge. They won't help us win outright, but they will at least cause any monsters attempting a sneak attack some trouble.
